svg.title: The hunt chain
svg.desc: Every random battle you win in a region adds one to its chain. Up to 5 wins there is no chance yet; then the next encounter may be the region's Rare Target: 20% at 6 wins, 40% at 7, 60% at 8, 80% at 9, certain at 10. The Rare Target fights alone at the region's level plus 5 with four times the HP, its colours turned 120 degrees on the colour wheel, and you can always run. It gives its region's rare Core (twice with the Hunter's Mark), an R-Booster pack and ten times the experience, and the Bestiary's Rare Cores line fills in. The chain resets in another region, after a Guardromon teleport and after fighting the Rare Target.
svg.text: Win random battles in one region. Past 5 wins, its Rare Target may come out instead.
Win in a row in one region
Alone, at the region's level +5, with 4x HP.
You can always run from it.

g.text: Datamon Core · x2 with the Hunter's Mark

svg.text: Battles you do not win do not count; battles the Overlevel Rush skips do.
